purpose: Verify recoverable native-copy ownership state after the accepted movie copy and safe repeat

capture.method: Existing NAS scheduled-backup container, nas --force; existing shared lock and retention policy preserved

independent_verification.method: Fetch the encrypted archive using the pinned dedicated NAS connection; verify ciphertext SHA-256; authenticate/decrypt with existing age identity and backup-qnap.decrypt_verify; validate manifest and every member; compare the native receipt against its live hash

limits: The new Plex archive was created successfully but not independently decrypted during this check; earlier Plex archive verification remains separate evidence.
No destination restore, Plex startup, device playback, whole-machine replacement or NAS-loss drill was performed.
No service was restarted, no media was acquired or copied, and queue state was not changed.
Restoring this receipt does not authorize adopting an unrelated destination directory.
